ceiling_analysis: PaySim R@1%FPR ceiling is ~49%. The dataset has only 8 columns (amount, balances, type, flags) with no entity IDs, timestamps, or behavioral sequences. Flow features are redundant with existing balance columns. The 49% ceiling is genuine: the ROC-AUC of 94.1% is good, but at 1% FPR the model can only recall 49% of fraud. At 5% FPR recall reaches 72%, at 10% FPR it reaches 82%.
